question: With which of the following sports do you associate the term '16-yard hit'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Field hockey.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **16 yard hit:**__

 __
 
• This is a hit taken by the team in defence 16 yards from the goal-line after the attacking team hits the ball over the baseline.
 
• Field hockey is a team sport of the hockey family.
 
• Each team plays with 11 players.
